items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: Eddie Jackson was playing with the band I was with when he died.

ctx.x: Was it the Onward Brass Band or the Excelsior? Yeah.

Might have been the... Eureka? I don't know what, I don't believe his band had their name. He just made up bands, you know? Ask him if man was the one. When he get a job, he hired a man, you know? And after the job was over, everything was over. Ask him did he know Eddie Jackson, a two-book line. That's a good idea. You want to know if you know Eddie Jackson?
